class.name: NNBTBlackboardSet
class.brief_description: Action leaf that writes a value to the blackboard.
class.description: Stores [member value] under [member key] in the tree's blackboard and returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS], or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] if the write is rejected or [member key] is empty. Use to set flags or values directly inside a behaviour tree without writing a custom script.
